title: Taking a SEAT: Predicting Value Interpretations from Sentiment, Emotion, Argument, and Topic Annotations

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating a language model's ability to predict individual, subjective human value interpretations of text by prompting it with an annotator's past Sentiment, Emotion, Argument, and Topic (SEAT) annotations, thereby avoiding reliance on aggregated majority labels or a single 'ground truth'.
